posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
At the risk of being the nay sayer...there might be some heros who don't ever get promo variants. Just like there might be heros who don't get a stand alone nemesis (Bunker jumps to mind. Frighttrain seems a pretty definitive arch rival, even though his only game presence is in the V5). It might sound rediculous, but it is a real possibility. If it doesn't fit into the larger story, theres no reason for a promo for promos sake.

Omnitron-X is honestly the least likely to recieve a promo of all the heros released. Why? Because I don't see him being in the overall story long enough or consistently enough to go through any major character changes (which promos tend to represent). From what we definitly know about the story, he gets blown to pieces early during Omnitron 1, comes back sporadically now and again due to time-travel shenanigans, but meets his ultimate fate at the hands of Omnitron-IV (as shown by the Tactics comics and his incap art).

Chrono is very likely to undergo some character development. We saw art teased of a Plauge Rat looking very different with the WotC pics from that email sent out, and if that story is continuing in some fashion, you can bet Chrono's will as well.

posts.name: Bas
posts.cooked:
Bas:

Do we yet know what the "Title Deck" from Shattered Timelines does? Is it a tab to store all our promos? Will it come with some new ones?

Wow, major brainfart… of course I meant WCos (or WotC or even WotCos, just to toss another option in there). Just speculating on potential additional promos, however unlikely that may be, since there will already be six promos included with this expansion.

I am looking very much forward to the storyline around Plague Rat though. From the new picture we saw a few weeks ago, I am beginning to think that RevoCorp has gotten its hands on him and harnessed him to do their bidding (similar to Spite, agent of Gloom, seems to have been steered by Gloomweaver). Reason for this is that the body-harness seems to include a collar with to little light on it, which to me suggest that the harness is under remote control.

Furthermore, since Omnitron is all about alternate timeline and time travel shenanigans, I would certainly not be surprised to see Omnitron-XI as a promo. Or even one of Omnitron IX; travelling to a later point in time than Omnitron-X and thus appearing later in the SotM-timeline.

Looking forward to what GtG have in store for us and the Multiverse!
